title: Software Engineering Technical Leader :: C/C++, Firmware & L2/L3 Networking |12-15 Years
teaser: Become part of our team as a Software Engineering Technical Leader, driving the design and development of high-performance system software for Cisco Meraki’s networking products. Lead the creation of firmware for L2/L3 protocols, ensuring seamless connectivity and performance. Ideal for experienced professionals with strong C/C++ expertise and a background in networking software development.
description:
Meet the Team

Are you a visionary firmware developer with a passion for computer networking? At Cisco Meraki, we’re revolutionizing the world of cloud-managed devices, including switches, routers and wireless access points. Our products are beloved by customers around the globe, and our rapid growth speaks volumes about the innovation behind what we do.

Join the Network Connectivity Team at Cisco Meraki, where your expertise will breathe life into our cutting-edge systems. As a Software Engineering Technical Lead you will be at the forefront of designing and developing high-performance system software that drives the future of networking technology.

Your Impact

In this pivotal role, Your work will directly enhance the connectivity and configuration of L2/L3 protocols on our switches, ensuring seamless management and impeccable performance for Meraki’s switches.. You will lead significant features and play a crucial part in shaping the future of switching.

Responsibilities

Architect networking components that are simple, scalable, and highly available. Design and development of  Firmware  for Cisco Meraki’s Switching, products.

Analyse requirements and problem statements to come with right software designs and solutions. To be able to write details Design documents and Functional Specifications.

To Code and Unit Test Software components and modules. It is required to have strong white- box testing and automating skills. Triage, debug, and root cause simulation, software bring-up, and customer failures

Work with local and remote teams to review Product Requirements Document,  to collaborate on SW Functional and Design Specifications, Unit and Integration test plans. Also responsible for reviewing test strategy and test plans for Functional and System Test teams.

To be able to innovate and come up with new ideas that can lead to filing patents and creating IP value for the company

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelors (12-15 years) or Master’s degree(10-12 years) in Computer Science, EE/ECE or related fields.

Proficient in writing quality code in C/C++.

Experience in developing software/firmware for networking products.

Excellent knowledge of software architecture and system design.

Experience in Concurrent Programming and IPC/RPC Mechanisms

Expertise in Network Fundamentals (L2/L3): Your solid understanding of network basics will be your foundation.

Experience using Traffic generators/Analysers such as IXIA/Sniffer is a plus.

Technical leadership experience in leading high performance teams to provide technical leadership for designing and implementing quality features and solutions.

Hands on experience with Gen AI technologies (Codex, Claude etc.)

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with debugging and verification methodologies in C/C++.

You have hands-on development experience on L2, L3 protocols.

Cisco Networking certificates such as CCNA, CCNP, CCIE are desirable.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
